findings.title: Checker capacity was unavailable
findings.summary: The bounded checker supervisor had no execution slot, so service health was not established.

actions.title: Retry after capacity is available
actions.step: Repeat the check after existing checker work has completed.
actions.expected_result: The repeated check is admitted and completes with an observation.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the runtime owner if checker capacity remains unavailable.

findings.title: Checker execution failed
findings.summary: The checker stopped unexpectedly, so service health was not established.

actions.title: Repeat the failed check
actions.step: Repeat the bounded check and verify the checker runtime remains available.
actions.expected_result: The repeated checker completes with an observation.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the runtime owner if the checker repeatedly stops unexpectedly.

findings.title: Name resolution did not complete
findings.summary: The DNS check did not resolve the requested name.

actions.title: Verify DNS resolution
actions.step: Resolve the same hostname with the configured resolver and one known-good resolver.
actions.expected_result: The hostname returns at least one intended address consistently.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the DNS owner if the configured resolver still fails while the known-good resolver succeeds.

findings.title: Endpoint connection did not complete
findings.summary: The endpoint or service connection check failed.

actions.title: Verify endpoint reachability
actions.step: Retry the endpoint from the same vantage point and verify that the intended service is listening on the configured port.
actions.expected_result: A connection is accepted by the intended endpoint.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the network or service owner if the endpoint remains unreachable after the listener and access policy are verified.

findings.title: Check was cancelled
findings.summary: The check ended after cancellation, so service health was not established.

actions.title: Repeat the cancelled check
actions.step: Run the check again when the request can remain active through completion.
actions.expected_result: The repeated check completes with an observed result.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate if checks are repeatedly cancelled without an intentional caller cancellation.

findings.title: Traceroute attempts timed out
findings.summary: One or more traceroute attempts did not complete within their execution deadline.

actions.title: Repeat the timed-out trace
actions.step: Repeat the bounded trace from the same vantage point.
actions.expected_result: Every attempt completes before its deadline.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate if bounded attempts repeatedly time out after runtime availability is verified.

findings.title: Application returned an unexpected status
findings.summary: The observed HTTP status differs from the configured expectation.

actions.title: Verify the application response
actions.step: Request the same URL and verify the health endpoint, routing, and configured expected status.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint returns the configured expected HTTP status.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the application owner if the response remains unexpected after route and expectation configuration are verified.

findings.title: Target is invalid
findings.summary: The checker rejected the target before a network observation was possible.

actions.title: Correct the target
actions.step: Verify the target syntax, scheme, hostname, and port, then run the check again.
actions.expected_result: The corrected target is accepted and produces an observation.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the client or configuration owner if a valid target is still rejected.

findings.title: Service greeting was not verified
findings.summary: The transport connected, but the expected server-first service greeting was not verified.

actions.title: Verify the service greeting
actions.step: Verify that the intended service is listening and returns its expected server-first greeting without client input, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint returns the expected bounded server-first greeting.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the service owner if the expected greeting is still not verified after listener and protocol configuration are confirmed.

findings.title: Target is blocked by deployment policy
findings.summary: The public deployment policy rejected the target before a network connection was attempted.

evidence.expected: target permitted by the selected deployment policy

actions.title: Verify the deployment policy
actions.step: Use an approved public target, or run an explicitly trusted-local deployment for authorized private-network diagnostics.
actions.expected_result: The target is either approved or intentionally diagnosed from a trusted-local deployment.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the deployment owner instead of weakening the public-mode address policy.

findings.title: TLS certificate is expired
findings.summary: The TLS certificate was expired at the verification time.

actions.title: Renew the TLS certificate
actions.step: Renew and deploy the intended certificate chain, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint presents a certificate that is valid at verification time.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the certificate owner if a current certificate cannot be deployed.

findings.title: TLS certificate is near expiry
findings.summary: The observed peer certificate expires within 30 days of the analysis time.

evidence.expected: certificate valid beyond the 30-day renewal window

actions.title: Verify certificate renewal
actions.step: Confirm the deployed certificate chain and renewal schedule on the observed endpoint.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint presents a currently valid certificate with adequate renewal margin.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the certificate owner if renewal or deployment cannot be confirmed before expiry.

findings.title: TLS certificate is not yet valid
findings.summary: The TLS certificate was not yet valid at the verification time.

actions.title: Verify certificate activation
actions.step: Verify the endpoint certificate deployment and system clocks, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint presents a certificate that is valid at verification time.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the certificate owner if the validity window or deployment remains incorrect.

findings.title: TLS was not preserved
findings.summary: The HTTPS observation reported a TLS downgrade.

evidence.expected: verified TLS for every HTTPS response

actions.title: Verify TLS end to end
actions.step: Inspect each redirect and the final endpoint and verify that HTTPS is preserved throughout.
actions.expected_result: Every redirect and the final response use verified TLS.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the endpoint owner if any redirect or final response still leaves TLS.

findings.title: TLS handshake did not complete
findings.summary: The transport connected, but the TLS handshake failed.

actions.title: Verify the TLS endpoint
actions.step: Check the certificate chain, server name, protocol versions, and cipher compatibility, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: The TLS handshake completes with the intended endpoint.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the TLS endpoint owner if the handshake still fails with a valid trust chain and server name.

findings.title: TLS certificate name does not match
findings.summary: The TLS certificate did not match the requested server name.

actions.title: Correct the TLS server identity
actions.step: Deploy a certificate for the requested server name and verify endpoint routing, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: Certificate verification succeeds for the requested server name.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the TLS endpoint owner if the intended name still does not verify.

findings.title: TLS certificate is not trusted
findings.summary: The TLS certificate chain did not verify to a trusted authority.

actions.title: Correct the TLS trust chain
actions.step: Deploy the intended complete certificate chain and verify its trust anchor, then repeat the check.
actions.expected_result: The endpoint certificate chain verifies to an approved trust anchor.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the certificate owner if the intended chain remains untrusted.

findings.title: Traceroute command attempts failed
findings.summary: One or more traceroute command attempts did not produce a completed route observation.

evidence.observed: 2 execution failures: 1 timed out, 1 cancelled, 0 command errors

actions.title: Verify traceroute execution
actions.step: Verify the traceroute executable and permissions, then repeat the bounded check.
actions.expected_result: Every command attempt completes and produces a parseable route observation.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the runtime owner if traceroute command attempts still cannot complete.

findings.title: Traceroute reachability varied across completed attempts
findings.summary: Some completed traceroute attempts reached the destination and others did not.

actions.title: Compare repeated routes
actions.step: Compare reached and unreached completed attempts for the first stable divergence while preserving the same vantage point.
actions.expected_result: Repeated completed attempts show consistent reachability or a reproducible divergence.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate with both route sets if the variation persists.

findings.title: A degraded route segment was observed
findings.summary: The traceroute producer classified at least one completed route hop or link as degraded.

evidence.observed: degraded segment observed among 1 completed attempt
evidence.expected: no producer-classified degraded segment in completed path evidence

actions.title: Verify the degraded segment
actions.step: Repeat the trace and compare the same hop transition across completed attempts and another approved vantage point.
actions.expected_result: The repeated observations show whether the segment status remains degraded.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate with the repeated hop and route observations if the segment status remains degraded.

findings.title: Traceroute paths varied across attempts
findings.summary: Successful completed attempts observed more than one hop sequence from the same vantage point.

evidence.observed: multiple successful completed path signatures among 2 reached completed attempts
evidence.expected: one stable successful completed path signature

actions.title: Compare path variants
actions.step: Repeat the bounded trace and compare the first hop where successful completed paths diverge.
actions.expected_result: The path stabilizes or the same divergence is reproduced.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate with the successful completed path variants if the divergence persists.

findings.title: Traceroute is unavailable
findings.summary: No functional traceroute capability was established at startup, so route health was not observed.

evidence.expected: functional traceroute capability established at startup

actions.title: Restore traceroute capability
actions.step: Install or repair the supported traceroute executable, then restart the service so startup can probe it.
actions.expected_result: The restarted service reports ready and a traceroute check produces an observation.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate to the runtime owner if the startup capability probe remains unavailable.

findings.title: No completed traceroute attempt reached the destination
findings.summary: The destination was not observed as reached in any completed traceroute attempt.

actions.title: Verify the route from the same vantage point
actions.step: Repeat the bounded trace and compare the last responsive hop and destination reachability.
actions.expected_result: At least one completed trace reaches the destination or identifies a stable last responsive hop.
actions.escalation_condition: Escalate with the recorded hops if repeated completed traces still do not reach the destination.
